svg.aria-label: Deliverable 13, how the parts fit: Newer stellar-xdr, core (pinned fixtures); Coverage gate (fails on a new arm); Upgrade drill (the gate fails, then closes); Readiness report (which SDKs read the shapes); v1.0 release (checksums · attestation); Maintenance runbook (public).
